title: Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning for Domain Generalization
full_venue: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2024
abstract: We propose a semantic-aware contrastive framework that improves generalization across shifting domains in visual recognition tasks.

title: Uncertainty-Guided Pseudo Labeling for Low-Resource Learning
abstract: A novel uncertainty estimation strategy for pseudo labeling that significantly boosts performance on limited labeled data.

title: Enhancing LLM Reasoning via Thought-Aware Fine-Tuning
full_venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL), 2023
abstract: We introduce thought-aware fine-tuning (TAFT) to improve reasoning and factual consistency in large language models.

title: Efficient Sparse Attention for Long-Context Vision Transformers
full_venue: NeurIPS Workshop on Efficient Natural Language and Speech Processing, 2024
abstract: A content-aware sparse attention scheme that reduces memory by 4x while matching dense attention accuracy on long visual sequences.

title: Robust Representations Under Distribution Shift: A Survey
abstract: A structured review of methods for learning representations that remain reliable under covariate, label and concept shift.

title: Self-Supervised Pretraining with Masked Feature Prediction
abstract: We show that predicting masked semantic features, rather than pixels, yields stronger transfer for dense prediction tasks.

title: Reproducible Training Pipelines for Large-Scale Vision Models
authors: **Kazi Fahad**, D. Engineer, A. Researcher, I. Advisor
full_venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, vol. 45, 2023
abstract: An open framework and set of best practices for deterministic, auditable training of vision models at scale.

title: Cross-Lingual Transfer for Low-Resource Bangla NLP
full_venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), 2022
abstract: We study cross-lingual transfer from high-resource languages and release a benchmark for Bangla text classification and NER.

title: Calibrated Uncertainty for Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: A lightweight calibration layer that produces trustworthy pixel-level uncertainty for clinical segmentation models.
